title: Classical Shadows 3^w Variance Penalty vs. Commuting X^K Derandomized Witness Readout
claims: Under uniform {X, Y, Z}^{otimes K} randomized Pauli shadow tomography, any weight-w X-type witness parity observable O_m has single-snapshot hit probability 3^{-w} and exact variance 3^w - <O_m>^2.

Derandomizing into the commuting basis X^{otimes K} measures all 2^K - 1 X-parities simultaneously with hit probability 1.0 and variance 1 - <O_m>^2, reducing required samples by (3^w - mu^2) / (1 - mu^2) >= 3^w.
favorable_controls: Weights w in {1, 2, 3, 4, 5} at mu = 0.25 (>28.7x reduction at w=3; >86.3x reduction at w=4)
